operands.sourceEvidence: §6.01(b)(13)(a): "or requires no or nominal payments in cash (other than interest payments) prior to the date that is ninety-one (91) days after the maturity date of the Loans"
operands.semanticDescription: Alternative qualifying test: Refinancing Indebtedness requires no or only nominal payments in cash (other than interest payments) prior to the date 91 days after the maturity date of the Loans.
operands.reason: 'Nominal' cash payments is a qualitative standard with no numeric threshold supplied in the source text.

conditions.description: Weighted Average Life to Maturity (WAL) test: except in the case of a Maturity Exception Facility, the Refinancing Indebtedness must have a WAL at incurrence not less than the remaining WAL of the debt being Refinanced, or alternatively require no or only nominal cash payments (other than interest) prior to the date 91 days after the Loans' maturity date.

Subordination/type matching: to the extent the Refinancing Indebtedness Refinances (i) Indebtedness subordinated in right of payment to the Loans or any Guarantee thereof, the Refinancing Indebtedness must be subordinated at least to the same extent, or (ii) Disqualified Stock or Preferred Stock, the Refinancing Indebtedness must itself be Disqualified Stock or Preferred Stock, respectively.

exceptions.description: The Weighted Average Life to Maturity test in clause (a) does not apply in the case of a Maturity Exception Facility.
Section 6.01(b)(13)(a)'s Weighted Average Life to Maturity requirement shall not apply to any Refinancing of any Secured Indebtedness.

Refinancing Indebtedness shall NOT include Indebtedness, Disqualified Stock or Preferred Stock of a Subsidiary of the Borrowers that is not a Guarantor, where such debt Refinances Indebtedness, Disqualified Stock or Preferred Stock of the Borrowers or a Guarantor.

Refinancing Indebtedness shall NOT include Indebtedness, Disqualified Stock or Preferred Stock of any Restricted Party that Refinances Indebtedness, Disqualified Stock or Preferred Stock of an Unrestricted Subsidiary.

conditions.description: Both the clause (a) and clause (b) ratio tests are measured after giving pro forma effect to the Investment, acquisition, merger, amalgamation or consolidation.

Clause (a): either (i) a Borrower would be permitted to incur at least $1.00 of additional Indebtedness under the Interest Coverage Ratio test in Section 6.01(a), or (ii) the Initial Borrower's Interest Coverage Ratio for the Test Period is equal to or greater than immediately prior to the transaction.

Clause (b): either (i) a Borrower would be permitted to incur at least $1.00 of additional Indebtedness under the Total Leverage Ratio test in Section 6.01(a), or (ii) the Initial Borrower's Total Leverage Ratio for the Test Period is equal to or less than immediately prior to the transaction.
